messages:
liz: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need explicit rules for auto-rollback around DB migrations and small canaries. Owners?

cheng: I can take sampling rules and a small simulator. Suggest min_rps=200 and min_instances=3 before any auto-rollback.

sam: I'll own rollback policy: propose cooldown=30m, max_rollbacks_per_hour=2, and require human confirm if migration flag is on.

amar: I'll add a migration label to deploy metadata and update SLO doc with migration exceptions. Also add a short note in the postmortem.

maria: I'll define customer-impacting vs infra-only signals: customer-facing 5xx >0.5% over 5m OR user error rate 2x baseline -> trigger immediate action. Infra-only needs human verification.

liz: Good. Also add canary ramp: 2% -> 10% over 10m with hold checks. If hold fails, rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout 2026-04-02T08:45:00Z started by @cheng (2% sampling)

cheng: Will add a tiny simulator to the PR to validate flapping on small sample sizes.

sam: I'll include unit tests for cooldown counters and rollback limits.

amar: Question: how do we detect migrations reliably? I'll wire deploy pipeline to set migration=true in metadata. If present, auto-rollback should be paused and require manual approval for customer-impact signals.

maria: For deduping amplified retries, use X-Request-ID header when available. Document fallback heuristics.

liz: Owners: cheng (sampling + simulator), sam (rollback + tests), amar (deploy metadata + SLO), maria (signals + test kit). Timeline: drafts by Tue, reviews Wed, ship v0 by Fri. Add PR links to postmortem when ready.

cheng: ack. I'll label tasks and open PR.

sam: ack. I'll add the cooldown config to the rollback engine.

amar: ack. Adding migration flag and audit step.

maria: ack. I'll prepare test scenarios for infra vs customer signals.

liz: Thanks team. We'll review simulator output in the follow-up meeting.
